{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the definition of 'loyal' customers
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction of loyal customers who converted
num_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
num_converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = num_converted_loyal / num_loyal

# Ensure no division by zero
assert num_loyal > 0, "No loyal customers found"

fraction_converted"}
